title: Lumen Global Illumination & Reflections Overhead
fix_rationale: The GPU is heavily loaded by Lumen diffuse indirect illumination, screen probe gathering, or Lumen reflections.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) computing Lumen dynamic lighting.

fixes.text: Tune Lumen Screen Probe Gather downsample factor (r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFactor 16).
Adjust Lumen Diffuse Indirect and Reflection quality or toggle off in lower scalability tiers.
Lower Lumen max trace distance and scene detail in PostProcessVolume settings.
Use Software Ray Tracing rather than Hardware Ray Tracing if high mesh instance counts cause ray tracing BVH build overhead.

verify: Toggle r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.Allow or adjust r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFactor and confirm GPU pass times drop.
